speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you have a history of easy bruising and are experiencing persistent bleeding after your wisdom tooth extraction. To better understand the extent of this issue, could you describe how long the bleeding has lasted and what measures you've taken to stop it?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A.
I have identified the key clinical features: a 17-year-old male with hemarthrosis (joint swelling), a family history affecting an uncle, and spontaneous/traumatic bleeding (easy bruising, post-extraction) that is minimally responsive to pressure. These findings strongly suggest an X-linked coagulation factor deficiency. The diagnosis is Hemophilia A.
